m0-context.title: Load context and verify handoff completeness
m0-context.imperative: Read CREW_CONTEXT.md and the handoff. Verify task, intent, scope, exclusions, evidence requirements, test mode, stop conditions are all present. Attest c1.

postconditions.statement: handoff complete: task=bulldoze dead pathways, intent=no parallel estimators, scope=listed files only, exclusions=physics/evo/latent, evidence=grep+imports+tests, test-mode=evidence-only for deletions, stop-conditions=live importer found or physics touched

m1-predelete-grep.title: Pre-delete import verification
m1-predelete-grep.imperative: Run the verification grep to confirm no live (non-dead-test) importers of any removal target exist outside src/preprocessing/ itself. If any live importer found, STOP and report blocker.

postconditions.statement: grep returns no live importers outside src/preprocessing/ and the listed dead tests

m2-delete-src.title: Delete src/preprocessing legacy source files
m2-delete-src.imperative: Use git rm to delete all listed src/preprocessing/*.py and subdirectories: windowed_estimator.py, windowed_config.py, windowed_solver/, trajectory_models.py, consensus_stitcher.py, coordinate_transform.py, curvature.py, spline_basis.py, measurement_models.py, loess_bootstrap.py, robust_reweighter.py, irls_reweighter.py, trajectory_grading/. Do NOT touch src/preprocessing/trajectory/ or __init__.py.

preconditions.statement: pre-delete grep confirmed no live importers

constraints: Do NOT touch src/physics, src/evo_predictor, src/latent_power

m3-delete-tests.title: Delete dead test files
m3-delete-tests.imperative: Use git rm to delete all 12 listed dead test files. Do NOT delete tests/unit/preprocessing/__init__.py.

postconditions.statement: 12 dead test files removed from git

constraints: Do NOT delete tests/unit/preprocessing/__init__.py or any live test

m4-delete-docs.title: Delete retired docs
m4-delete-docs.imperative: Use git rm to delete docs/physics/windowed_estimator.md and docs/report_schemas/trajectory_grading_report.md. Do NOT touch docs/physics/measurement_model.md.

postconditions.statement: both retired doc files removed; measurement_model.md still present

m5-delete-scripts.title: Delete orphaned scripts importing windowed lineage
m5-delete-scripts.imperative: Grep scripts/ for imports of any deleted modules. Delete (git rm) only scripts that import from the windowed lineage. If none found, attest 'no orphaned scripts'.

postconditions.statement: no scripts/ files import deleted modules

constraints: Only delete scripts that import deleted modules

m6-rewrite-init.title: Rewrite src/preprocessing/__init__.py
m6-rewrite-init.imperative: Rewrite src/preprocessing/__init__.py to export only the new trajectory public API (re-export from src.preprocessing.trajectory), removing all windowed/ribbon re-exports. Update module docstring. Must import cleanly.

postconditions.statement: import src.preprocessing succeeds; no reference to deleted modules

m7-write-schema-doc.title: Write docs/report_schemas/trajectory_trust_profile.md
m7-write-schema-doc.imperative: Read src/preprocessing/trajectory/artifact.py and grading.py first to understand exact fields written. Write the new schema doc: producer, consumer, all fields (t/X/Y/V, acceleration state, position covariance, HPs, held-out chi2, NIS summary, sector-crossing residuals, schema_version), units (m, m/s, m/s2, seconds).
constraints: Match artifact.py actual fields; do not invent fields

m8-update-doc-refs.title: Update narrative doc references
m8-update-doc-refs.imperative: Grep docs/ for windowed_estimator, windowed_solver, trajectory_grading, consensus_stitcher references. Fix or remove stale references in narrative docs. Do NOT edit architecture packet/index.

postconditions.statement: no stale references to deleted modules in non-architecture narrative docs

m9-verify-all.title: Run all close criteria verification
m9-verify-all.imperative: Run: (1) ls src/preprocessing/, (2) import checks, (3) simplification_limits --paths src/preprocessing, (4) post-delete grep (expect empty), (5) git diff --stat on physics/evo/latent, (6) fast test suite py -m pytest tests/unit tests/integration -q -m 'not slow' -p no:cacheprovider.

postconditions.statement: all close criteria pass: ls clean, imports clean, simplification clean, post-grep empty, diff-stat shows no physics/evo/latent changes, tests pass

check.command: py -m pytest tests/unit tests/integration -q -m "not slow" -p no:cacheprovider --ignore=tests/integration/test_trajectory_spain_reproduction.py 2>&1 | tail -20

m10-write-evidence.title: Write evidence files and IMPLEMENTER_RESULT
m10-write-evidence.imperative: Write .agent-work/issue-448-prod/evidence/removal_summary.md with deletion counts by category, pre/post grep, import checks, simplification, git diff --stat. Write g3-implement-result.md using IMPLEMENTER_RESULT template.

postconditions.statement: both files written with all required evidence
